slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Working code can still be the wrong product
slides.subtitle: A vague prompt makes the agent decide product scope for you.

slides.title: The prompt was too small
slides.body: I asked for a weekly feedback tool. The agent built a CLI for weekly project health. It worked, but it was not the retrospective workflow I wanted.

slides.title: The missing decisions mattered
slides.body: The prompt did not define users, feedback format, anonymity, voting, reveal timing, clustering, or action items.

slides.title: Agents fill gaps
slides.body: When important product details are missing, the model has to invent them. Those assumptions often differ from what you had in mind.

slides.title: Specify before coding
slides.body: Write down users, workflow, MVP scope, out-of-scope items, and decisions the agent should avoid making.

slides.supportingText: Spec-driven development for AI coding agents.
